notes.title: Optimization update
notes.notes:
Version 1.2

List of changes:

- Shader optimization
- Optimization of lighting
- Shadow optimization
- Fixed an error that occurs when reading notes 
- Small changes in the landscape
- Now it starts snowing at night

notes.title: Bugfix №1
notes.notes:
Version 1.1

- Added the ability to save game progress.
- Fixed points and areas of interaction with objects\ environment.
- Fixed a bug where the task list was displayed incorrectly.
- Redesigned shopping list.
- Fixed a number of in-game PC bugs.
- Localization edits.
- Fixed a bug where it was not possible to get up from the table.
- Other minor edits. 

------------------------

Known bugs: Enabling pause while reading notes causes the game to freeze. To show/hide a note, press the "E" key.

notes.title: A demo version is available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
HappyJack is in touch.

I am glad to announce that the demo has finally been released and is ready to participate in the festival. It was not without difficulties, I wanted to see the demo version in a slightly different state, nevertheless, it is there. 
Everything that I did not manage to implement/finalize will be fixed in the near future.

If you encounter errors, difficulties during the gameplay, or you have suggestions for improving it, I will be glad to receive feedback. You can write in the comments under this post, or in a special topic in the discussions.
